# Madain Project

> > A comprehensive digital archive documenting archaeological sites, ancient monuments, and historical landmarks across the Mediterranean, Middle East, and Arabian Peninsula.

The Madain Project catalogs significant archaeological sites from ancient civilizations including Roman, Nabataean, Islamic, Greek, and Biblical periods. The database provides detailed documentation of structures, ruins, and artifacts with scholarly citation formats (APA, MLA, Chicago) for academic use.

## Key Topics

- Archaeology
- Ancient Rome
- Roman Architecture
- Nabataean Civilization
- Islamic Architecture
- Roman Forum
- Petra
- Jerusalem
- Masjid al-Nabawi
- Archaeological Sites
- Ancient Ruins
- Roman Temples
- Abrahamic History
- Seventh Century
- Saudi Arabia

## Roman Architecture & Sites

- [Capitoline Hill](https://madainproject.com/capitoline_hill): Most important of Rome's seven hills, between Forum and Campus Martius
- [Domus Aurea](https://madainproject.com/domus_aurea): Nero's vast palatial complex across Palatine, Oppian, and Caelian hills
- [Curia Julia](https://madainproject.com/curia_julia): Third Roman senate house built by Julius Caesar in 44 BCE
- [Basilica Aemilia](https://madainproject.com/basilica_aemilia): Public basilica in Roman Forum built by censors Lepidus and Nobilior
- [Archaeological Regions of Pompeii](https://madainproject.com/archaeological_regions_of_pompeii): Fiorelli's nine regiones division system for excavated Pompeii districts
- [Baalbek](https://madainproject.com/baalbek): Ancient Heliopolis in Lebanon's Beqaa Valley with Roman temple complex

## Nabataean & Ancient Near East

- [al-Khazneh Burial Crypt](https://madainproject.com/al_khazneh_crypt): Underground Nabataean burial chambers beneath Petra's Treasury monument
- [Avdat](https://madainproject.com/avdat): Nabataean city ruins in Negev desert, key stop on ancient Incense Route
- [Bosra](https://madainproject.com/bosra): Ancient Syrian town in Hauran region, Daraa Governorate
- [al-Bad'a](https://madainproject.com/al_bada): Biblical Midian site in Tabuk with 5,000 years of archaeological remains

## Islamic Heritage Sites

- [as-Salam Gate (Masjid al-Nabawi)](https://madainproject.com/as_salam_gate_(masjid_al_nabawi)): Major western gate of Masjid al-Nabawi, near Rawda e Rasool in Medina
- [al-Qamus Fort (Khaybar)](https://madainproject.com/al_qamus_fort_(khaybar)): Last Jewish stronghold in Khaybar oasis, northwestern Arabia
- [Coin of Ibn Marwan](https://madainproject.com/coin_of_ibn_marwan): First Islamic gold dinar introduced by Abd al-Malik in 693 CE

## Greek & Hellenistic Sites

- [Acropolis of Pergamon](https://madainproject.com/acropolis_of_pergamon): Attalid dynasty fortified center in Hellenistic Pergamon, Turkey
- [Crete](https://madainproject.com/crete): Minoan civilization birthplace with palatial centers like Knossos
- [Archaeological Site of Ancient Cuma](https://madainproject.com/archaeological_site_of_ancient_cuma): 8th century BCE Greek colony site with Cave of Sibyl and temple ruins

## Christian Holy Sites

- [Chapel of Mary Magdalene (Holy Sepulchre)](https://madainproject.com/chapel_of_mary_magdalene_(holy_sepulchre)): Franciscan chapel in Holy Sepulchre's Rotunda dedicated to Mary Magdalene
- [Church of Mary Magdalene (Jerusalem)](https://madainproject.com/church_of_mary_magdalene_(jerusalem)): Russian Orthodox church on Mount of Olives near Garden of Gethsemane
